verdict.rationale: Workable publishes a documented public REST API (v3) with token authentication, per-endpoint scopes, and broad coverage: jobs, candidates, ratings, offers, stages, requisitions, members, departments and events. The docs also offer an llms.txt index, markdown pages and a live Try It runner, so a user or agent can drive the product programmatically. missing for 10: no published machine-readable OpenAPI spec (download disabled, spec paths 404), no test/sandbox base URL or test keys, no API changelog or deprecation policy, no independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: We provide you with an API that gives you full control over your data.
